semanticConstraints: Each duration must be positive and at most Int32.MaxValue milliseconds; connection/command must fit operation and lock must fit command.

ConnectionTimeout is additionally at most1024000 milliseconds: native Npgsql Timeout is the positive duration rounded up to whole seconds and must not exceed1024 seconds. CommandTimeout is likewise rounded up to at least one whole second; CancellationTimeout rounds up to whole milliseconds. These fallbacks do not replace the independently enforced stage deadlines.

ConnectionString is secret, required and parsed by the native NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder. Native policy overrides connection/command/cancellation timeout fallbacks and always enables reset-on-close.
PolicyName is application-owned; stable datasource/context-unit ownership is established by explicit AddFoundationPostgreSql registration. No metadata export creates a datasource or connects.
Binding occurs at shell composition; each provider generation owns its validated immutable snapshot and existing work drains before disposal.
